summary: This directory provides foundational filesystem interaction utilities and services. It encapsulates logic for normalizing file paths, searching for files based on criteria, and managing file access synchronization via locking mechanisms to ensure safe operations.
responsibilities: Normalize and manipulate file system paths
Perform filtered file searches within the filesystem
Manage file accessibility and concurrent access through synchronization locks
relationships: The search service utilizes path definitions to locate and return filesystem entries.
File access services use entry paths to verify permissions and manage locks on specific resources.
Path normalization utilities ensure consistent representation of filesystem locations across the search and access services.
designDecisions: Strong typing for path representations to enforce consistency
Centralized path normalization to handle platform-specific inconsistencies
Synchronized access management to handle file concurrency
